source.provenanceLimit: Existing local sample outside the repository. It was used in scratch-only CLI and selector runs; it was not staged or committed.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files
authority.relevantRoles: The dictionary parent is a soft relative pointer, reactors are soft pointers, xdicobjhandle is a hard owner, and itemhandles are soft owners.

finding.before: After S23 preserved the LAYER_CONTROL proof through CLI export, strict preflight rejected the rooted ACAD_SCALELIST dictionary. The selected physical SCALE helper had been misread as generating its input; it is a readback-only selector and requires an already-created output file.
finding.cause: The DICTIONARY parser marks its common-link tail validated only after decoding the common handles and all counted item handles within the object frame and checking their roles. prepareDwgScales rejected a dictionary when this validation marker was present, inverting the fail-closed predicate.
finding.after: SCALE output preparation now requires hasDwgCommonLinkTail(). Debug diagnostics distinguish the preparation and output-snapshot rejection conditions. Strict CLI no longer rejects at ACAD_SCALELIST. The LayerStates profile separately skips this source because its root precondition is absent; strict finalization then refuses at the opaque-callback completeness boundary.

implementation.productionChange: Require the validated DICTIONARY common-link tail when admitting the source-bound ACAD_SCALELIST graph. Preserve strict output refusal for dictionaries whose link tail was not decoded and role-checked.
implementation.diagnosticChange: Split combined SCALE snapshot and OBJECTS-view checks into reason-specific debug messages.
implementation.selectorChange: Import the physical source through one dx_iface, project only its rooted 17-record SCALE profile, verify a supplied DXF, inject a post-OBJECTS source mutation, assert destination preservation, restore the model, retry with the same writer, and freshly reimport the result.

partialCliOutput.result: PASS; used only as an explicit partial-conversion output input for the selected-profile physical readback; this does not establish whole-drawing completeness.

physicalSelector.result: PASS. The selected route freshly reads 17 SCALE identities, ACAD_SCALELIST NOD membership/order, dictionary owner, one reactor per SCALE, and exact typed/raw flag, name, paper units, drawing units, and unit-scale fields.
physicalSelector.failureAndRetry: A late post-OBJECTS paperUnits mutation is rejected as a changed source snapshot. The preexisting destination sentinel remains byte-identical. Restoring the source model and retrying on the same writer succeeds; fresh reimport validates the complete selected profile.

strictCli.result: EXPECTED_FAIL_CLOSED. No ACAD_SCALELIST snapshot rejection occurs. The LayerStates profile skips this source because its LAYER_CONTROL root precondition is absent. Strict finalization stops at opaque DWG callback completeness: 225/228 qualified. Unqualified callbacks are handle 0x24/type 73, 0x34/type 82, and 0x89/type 82. No strict output file is published.

limits: The physical selector proves only the selected SCALE graph and its emitted DXF representation; it is not whole-drawing conversion evidence.
The three remaining opaque callbacks still block strict AC1024 output.
No repository DWG/DXF fixture was added, and no broad DWG/DXF or FreeCAD support claim is promoted.
